text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
We deeply apologize for the inconvenience! 
Due to an unexpected 
accident, we are experiencing a power 
shortage and have temporarily paused the 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Are they okay? It looks pretty 
bad... 
Isn't there anything... anything we can do 
to help?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
If anyone needs to move, we can provide 
you with flashlights! Please feel free to— 
Oh, would you like one? It might bring you 
some peace of mind to have light!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm okay, but... 
Peace of mind with light, huh... ......

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, big bro, what are you doing? 
Leaving your phone flashlight on will 
drain the battery, you know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... how should I put this? 
I just want to give them some peace of 
mind!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—! If that's why, count me in too! Wait, 
if everyone did this, wouldn't it get 
pretty bright in here!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lights began to flicker on, one by one, 
throughout the darkened venue. 
Before I knew it, I was raising my 
illuminated phone into the air, too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if cheering on the girls who had 
brought them so much joy up until now, 
the audience had transformed into a 
dazzling "sea of lights"—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I was planning on giving something. 
—Yet I ended up receiving it instead.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But that's so true! That's what marvelous 
is all about!! 
Something we make together☆ Something we 
find together★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So surely, this "sea of lights" everyone 
made for us is the crystallization of our 
marvelous, and... —Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Hey! I just had an idea! 
A way to welcome an extra-large marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Thank you, everyone! 
A sparkling sea! It's sooooo marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to this, I was able to walk all the 
way here! 
Because of everyone's lights! Without 
getting lost on the way to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? Have you noticed? The 
sea of lights everyone made— 
it's reflecting up above, too. Look, gaze 
up at the ceiling!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my? Can't see it yet? —Aha. 
Then I'll show you right now! Here we 
goooo☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes...! Everyone, are you ready? 
Match your breathing, all together...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous and Co.
text_block_list.text: 3, 2, 1! MAAAARVELOOOUS☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!? 
What is this... The circus tent is...!!!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(...What splendid quick thinking. If we 
cannot project the deep sea, then 
connecting it to the sea of lights 
everyone provided—and using the real 
starry sky instead...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad. —Glad that we're here in 
Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to the crystal-clear air, the 
stars and the moon—they are acting as our 
stage equipment. With this much light, we 
can put on the performance we envisioned.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(...Fufu. Perhaps... from the very moment 
we decided to do this here, 
this grand finale was already promised—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One month before the circus—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Truth is! 
The circus—I want to do it in Hokkaido☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? A circus in Hokkaido...? What do 
you mean? 
Isn't that for the Holy Hoof Festival? 
Shouldn't we be doing it at the Academy?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yup, that's true! 
But marvelous needs to be delivered 
nationwide!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So, you see! Let's leap right out☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A-Are you serious...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Marvelous can be conveyed 
through a screen, too! 
Even so, I want to go meet everyone in 
other regions in person!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because when handed over in person, 
marvelous becomes 
waaaay more marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
People who can't come see the Holy Hoof 
Festival! People who can't watch races 
live! 
What if the circus went straight to people 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ They'd definitely be surprised! 
Absolutely all smiles! 
Now that is super marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So, if such wonderfulness is waiting for 
us— 
We just gotta go☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Unreal. 
You for real?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing! 
Damn, that's crazy good vibes right there!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I understand your enthusiasm. However, 
as it stands, merely holding a circus has 
already drawn concerns regarding 
"staffing" and "safety."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, if we hold it off-campus... 
the hurdles we must clear will inevitably 
be on an entirely different level compared 
to an on-campus project.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yup, that's true. 
That's why—all together! We'll find a way! 
Ohhh☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fuji~! Good work today! Ahaha☆ 
The livestream was so much fun! Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you! 
That's the exact feedback I wanted to hear 
most.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, right. The promotion seems to have 
been a success. We've already started 
receiving staff applications from people 
in other regions who watched the stream!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The ones from the recruitment on Umatter!? 
Yayyy☆ 
It reached them, our marvelous! Right to 
everyone out there!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all that hard work paid off. With 
this, it looks like we'll manage to gather 
enough local staff.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... alright! Our chances of success 
might have just gone up! 
At this rate, the actual show will—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
MAAARVELOOOUS☆★☆ Everyone's performance 
became totally flawless! It's all thanks 
to Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? That's not true at all~. 
All I did was help everyone loosen up 
their nerves.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Since we're going all the way out there, 
it's only natural to think, "We can't show 
them anything subpar!" 
—I completely understand feeling pressured 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So really, this is just everyone's true 
ability~. 
I'm just happy it's shining through now♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We're heeere☆ 
Hakodate, let's gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay☆★☆ Tomorrow's the big day! 
I hope a loooot of people come to see us★

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Alright, let's hurry up and go 
check out the tent~♪ 
I'll guide you to the exit! It's closer 
from this way!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! You know your way around! 
Have you been to this airport before?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pretty much! I've raced here a bunch of 
times. 
I mean...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to come. 
One more time. Back here.
